ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-1: Zero-price bypass — SqrtPriceCalculator.computeRatioX96() returns 0 on overflow, validateHandlerOrder may not check zero
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow (line 53). In validateHandlerOrder (AMMStandardHook.sol:217-224), if bounds.minSqrtPriceX96 != 0 then 0 < min triggers revert. If minSqrtPriceX96 == 0 and maxSqrtPriceX96 is set, 0 > max is false so it passes — but this only affects the no-min-bound case. In afterSwap path (line 847), sqrtPriceX96 == 0 now explicitly reverts with AMMStandardHook__InvalidPrice. Known low severity (CP-003).
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMStandardHook.sol:215-224,847-849 — zero return handled by explicit revert in afterSwap, bounded check in validateHandlerOrder

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-2: Direct handler call — calling CLOBTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer() directly bypasses pricing enforcement
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOBTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer (line 230) checks msg.sender != AMM and reverts with CLOBTransferHandler__CallbackMustBeFromAMM. No external caller can invoke the handler directly. PermitTransferHandler has identical guard.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: CLOBTransferHandler.sol:229-232 — msg.sender == AMM guard blocks all external calls

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-3: Settings sync gap — setTokenSettings syncs original settings (without initialized=true) to hooks
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CreatorHookSettingsRegistry.setTokenSettings (line 397) passes original calldata settings to registryUpdateTokenSettings, which stores them without initialized=true. However, AMMStandardHook._getOrFetchTokenSettings (line 908-918) handles this: if !initialized, it re-fetches from registry and sets initialized=true. This causes an extra SLOAD (gas waste) but no state corruption or insolvency. Known low severity (CP-005).
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: CreatorHookSettingsRegistry.sol:376-398 and AMMStandardHook.sol:907-918 — re-fetch on uninitialized cache is safe fallback

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-4: Transient storage leak — DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT not cleared after afterSwap reads it
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook beforeSwap writes to DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT (line 839) for direct swaps. afterSwap reads it (lines 843-844). The slot is NOT cleared after read. If two direct swaps occur in the same tx, the second afterSwap could read stale data from the first beforeSwap. This is the known HOOK-001/CP-001 pattern. Impact is limited to pricing bounds enforcement for direct swaps only, and only when beforeSwap flag is enabled but afterSwap flag is not for the second swap's token. Not an insolvency vector — no fund extraction path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan -> add liquidity -> swap -> remove liquidity -> repay creates profit
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Forge fuzz test with 5000 runs: flash loan + swap + reverse swap always results in attacker losing money due to pool fees. INV-E02 invariant holds across all tested amounts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Round-trip swap extraction via rounding asymmetry
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fuzz test confirms swap(A->B) then swap(B->A) always results in A_final <= A_initial. Rounding consistently favors protocol (mulDivRoundingUp for input, mulDiv for output). INV-SW02 holds.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust-loop extraction via 100+ tiny swaps harvesting truncation rounding
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: 100 sequential 1-wei swaps: pool never loses value in both tokens simultaneously. Rounding favors protocol at every step. Even with zero fees, rounding prevents extraction.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reentrancy during _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers via ERC-777 token callback
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) at line 3190 preserves the ENTERED bit (bit 1). Code at TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags.sol:68-71: flags are masked with ~(ENTERED | NOT_ENTERED), then OR'd with (currentGuard & ENTERED). ENTERED bit persists through flag clearing. Any attempt to call nonReentrant/nonReentrantWithFlags during hook fee transfer reverts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: tokensOwed desync between position and pool accounting
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: tokensOwed is accumulated via overflow-checked addition (AMMModule.sol:2943). Key derivation uses EfficientHash with LIQUIDITY_OWED prefix for LPs and hook address prefix for hook fees. No path exists to inflate tokensOwed without corresponding token transfer. _distributeOrCollectLiquidityToken only stores to tokensOwed when safeTransfer fails (line 1300), which is a fallback for the user — no insolvency created.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMModule.sol:2937-2948, 1298-1300 — overflow-checked accumulation, fallback-only storage

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Fee accumulation overflow leading to undercollateralization
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: 30 large alternating swaps (10e18 each direction): fee balances remain less than contract balance. feeBalance is uint128 (max ~3.4e38), and _safeIncrementUint128 reverts on overflow. Pool fee + protocol fee + exchange fee conservation verified: totalFees > amountIn reverts (line 1662).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Zero-liquidity fee collection overflow in DynamicHelper
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: DynamicHelper.computeSwap (line 404-408): feeGrowthGlobalX128 only updated when swapCache.liquidity > 0. At zero liquidity, fees are collected but not distributed to feeGrowthGlobal, preventing division by zero. Unchecked overflow in Q128.128 is intentional by-design (wrapping arithmetic, same as Uniswap v3).
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: DynamicHelper.sol:404-408 — liquidity > 0 guard prevents division by zero

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan fee denomination mismatch (feeToken != loanToken path)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: When feeToken != loanToken (line 3347-3370), separate balance checks are performed for each token independently. requiredTokenBalanceAfter for loanToken = pre-balance (must return exact loan amount). requiredFeeTokenBalanceAfter for feeToken = pre-balance + feeAmount. No cross-denomination possible — each token's balance is verified independently.
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: AMMModule.sol:3310-3371 — independent balance verification per token

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Native ETH refund path value leak in _depositWrappedNativeAndRefundExcess
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Forge test confirms: sending exact ETH consumes exactly that amount. Sending excess ETH refunds the difference. msg.value < amountIn reverts. No value leak path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Token balance solvency violation after mixed operations
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: 50-operation fuzz test (random swap directions, random amounts, seed-based): contractBalance(token) >= reserve + feeBalance for both tokens in all runs. INV-S01 holds.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Liquidity withdrawal guarantee failure after swaps
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: After 20 random swaps, reserves remain non-zero when pool has liquidity. All active positions can remove liquidity. INV-S03 holds.
